reason: This capture (recap2-esr-a) was recorded as an official, first-attempt registry_version 2 capture, but it was in fact a SECOND invocation for this case/config: the first invocation's output was silently lost to a shared-prompt-directory collision (see invalidated/error-swallow-to-raise/lost-generation-attempts/config-a.json for the honest incident record of that lost first attempt). registry_version 2's own invocation_protocol already declared one_attempt_only/no_retry, so generating and recording a second invocation after the first was silently overwritten -- however unintentional -- violates that declared invariant for this capture, independent of whether its content or protocol-commit verification otherwise holds (both do). Withdrawn and replaced with a genuinely first, one-shot invocation generated after registry_version 3 was committed, which adds unique_prompt_directory_per_invocation, output_directory_must_not_preexist, and exclusive_directory_creation specifically to make this class of defect structurally impossible.

discovered_by.method: Integrity review of the registry_version 2 recapture round identified that the surviving captures for these three cases were second invocations under a protocol that already declared one_attempt_only, because the true first invocations were lost to a directory collision rather than genuinely absent.
